Character sprites extracted from
Boku no xx wa Ryousei-tachi no Tokken Desu!
(ボクの××は寮生たちの特権です！).

This collection includes character sprites in four size variants:
S, M, L, and LL, as well as the Medio, Getchu, and additional sprite sets.

Due to the large number of files, the complete character sprite
collection has been divided into two galleries.

This gallery is Part 2 of 2.
